---
title: "Claustrum Connectivity in Prematurity CP-CD Agreement"
author: "Jil Wendt"
format: html
editor: visual
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: console
---

Agreement between CP- and CD-based group effects (Supplementary control and robustness analyses, section 1). Covariate-adjusted Cohen's d per target ROI (from `Revision_adjusted_effect_sizes.qmd`) are compared between metrics across ROIs (Pearson's r, Spearman's rho, sign agreement, Bland-Altman limits of agreement), and each ROI is classified by FDR-corrected significance for CP and CD. Subject-level concordance between CP and CD values is computed per ROI.

- Input: `data/effect_size_trajectory_CP_ADJ.csv`, `data/effect_size_trajectory_CD_ADJ.csv` (adjusted d, from `Revision_adjusted_effect_sizes.qmd`); `data/adults_harmonized.csv`, `data/dHCP_CP_cog_ses.csv`, `data/dHCP_CD_cog_ses.csv`
- Outputs:
  - `outputs/tables/Revision_agreement_CPvsCD_adj_<date>.csv`: agreement statistics (results/CP_CD_agreement_summary.csv)
  - `outputs/tables/Revision_agreement_CPvsCD_adj_TableR1<date>.csv`: classification per ROI (results/CP_CD_agreement_table.csv)
  - `outputs/tables/Revision_agreement_CPvsCD_subject_concordance_<date>.csv`: subject-level concordance (results/CP_CD_subject_concordance.csv)
  - `outputs/figures/Revision_FigR1_CP_CD_agreement_adj_<date>.png`: Supplementary Figure S7

## 1 Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(here)

fig_dir <- here::here("outputs", "figures")
tab_dir <- here::here("outputs", "tables")

save_plot_png <- function(plot, filename, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300) {
  outfile <- file.path(fig_dir, paste0(filename, "_", format(Sys.Date()), ".png"))
  ggplot2::ggsave(outfile, plot = plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
  message("Plot saved to: ", outfile)
  invisible(outfile)
}

cohort_labels <- c(dHCP = "Neonates (dHCP)", BLS = "Adults (BLS)")
```

### Load data BLS

```{r}
# --- Load data ---
dat <- read_delim(
  here("data", "adults_harmonized.csv"),
  delim = ";",
  trim_ws = TRUE,
  locale = locale(decimal_mark = ","),
  na = c(""," ","NA", "NaN", "n/a", ".", "-9999","999"),
  col_types = cols(
    Subject = col_character(),
    ID      = col_character()
  ),
  guess_max = 10000
) |> janitor::clean_names()

# --- recode and name important factors ---
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(case_when(
      groupcode == 0 ~ "FT",
      groupcode == 1 ~ "PT",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = c("FT", "PT")),
    
    sex = factor(case_when(
      sex == 1 ~ "Male",
      sex == 2 ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = c("Female", "Male"))
  )

# --- create sub-datasets --- 
drop_vars <- c("id") 

final_dat_CP <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(-starts_with("cd_"), -all_of(drop_vars))

final_dat_CD <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(-starts_with("cp_"), -all_of(drop_vars))
```

### Load data dHCP

```{r}
load_dHCP <- function(file) {
  readr::read_csv(here("data", file), na = c("", "NA", "NaN"),
                  show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    janitor::clean_names() |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      group = factor(dplyr::recode(group, term = "FT", pre = "PT"),
                     levels = c("FT", "PT")),
      sex   = factor(sex, levels = c("Female", "Male"))
    )
}

dat_dHCP_cp <- load_dHCP("dHCP_CP_cog_ses.csv")
dat_dHCP_cd <- load_dHCP("dHCP_CD_cog_ses.csv")

roi_cols_dHCP <- grep("_claustrum_", names(dat_dHCP_cp), value = TRUE)

# --- check data loaded ---
stopifnot(
  length(roi_cols_dHCP) == 22,
  setequal(roi_cols_dHCP, names(roi_labels_dHCP)),
  identical(dat_dHCP_cp$subject_id, dat_dHCP_cd$subject_id),
  identical(dat_dHCP_cp$group,      dat_dHCP_cd$group),
  !anyNA(dat_dHCP_cp$group),
  !anyNA(dat_dHCP_cp[roi_cols_dHCP]), !anyNA(dat_dHCP_cd[roi_cols_dHCP])
)
```

### Load adjusted effect size data

```{r}
d_cp <- read_csv2(here("data", paste0("effect_size_trajectory_CP_ADJ.csv")),
                  show_col_types = FALSE)
d_cd <- read_csv2(here("data", paste0("effect_size_trajectory_CD_ADJ.csv")),
                  show_col_types = FALSE)

ES <- inner_join(d_cp, d_cd, by = "ROI", suffix = c("_cp", "_cd"))
stopifnot(nrow(ES) == 22, !anyNA(ES))

ES_long <- bind_rows(lapply(c("dHCP", "BLS"), function(co) {
  tibble(ROI    = ES$ROI,
         cohort = co,
         d_cp   = ES[[paste0(co, "_d_cp")]],
         d_cd   = ES[[paste0(co, "_d_cd")]],
         p_cp   = ES[[paste0(co, "_p_cp")]],
         p_cd   = ES[[paste0(co, "_p_cd")]])
})) |>
  mutate(cohort = factor(cohort, levels = names(cohort_labels)),
         mean_d = (d_cp + d_cd) / 2,
         gap    = d_cp - d_cd)
```

# 2 Quantify agreement between CP and CD effect size

- sign convention: positive d \<-\> lower connectivity in PT individuals

- slope = OLS slope from lm(d_CD \~ d_CP)

### Summary statistics

```{r}
#| label: agreement
agree_tbl <- ES_long |>
  group_by(cohort) |>
  summarise(
    n              = n(),
    pearson_r      = cor(d_cp, d_cd),
    r_ci_lo        = cor.test(d_cp, d_cd)$conf.int[1],
    r_ci_hi        = cor.test(d_cp, d_cd)$conf.int[2],
    spearman_rho   = cor(d_cp, d_cd, method = "spearman"),
    sign_agree     = sum(sign(d_cp) == sign(d_cd)),
    slope_cd_on_cp = unname(coef(lm(d_cd ~ d_cp))[2]),
    mean_gap       = mean(gap),
    loa_lo         = mean(gap) - 1.96 * sd(gap),
    loa_hi         = mean(gap) + 1.96 * sd(gap),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

### Classification per ROI (Supplementary Table S19)

Based on the FDR-corrected ANCOVAs for CP (Table S2) and CD (Table S3): both, CP only, CD only, or neither significant; direction in parentheses.

```{r}
#| label: classification
dir_lab <- function(d) ifelse(d > 0, "FT > PT", "FT < PT")

class_tbl <- ES_long |>
  mutate(
    sig_cp = p_cp < 0.05,
    sig_cd = p_cd < 0.05,
    agreement = case_when(
      sig_cp & sig_cd & sign(d_cp) == sign(d_cd) ~ paste0("Both (", dir_lab(d_cp), ")"),
      sig_cp & sig_cd                            ~ "Both, opposite directions",
      sig_cp                                     ~ paste0("CP only (", dir_lab(d_cp), ")"),
      sig_cd                                     ~ paste0("CD only (", dir_lab(d_cd), ")"),
      TRUE                                       ~ "Neither"
    )
  )

tab_r1 <- class_tbl |>
  transmute(ROI, cohort,
            d_cp = round(d_cp, 3), d_cd = round(d_cd, 3), agreement) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = cohort, values_from = c(d_cp, d_cd, agreement),
              names_glue = "{cohort}_{.value}") |>
  select(ROI, starts_with("dHCP_"), starts_with("BLS_"))
```

```{r}
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)

p_ba <- ggplot(ES_long, aes(mean_d, gap)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey75") +
  geom_hline(data = agree_tbl, aes(yintercept = mean_gap)) +
  geom_hline(data = agree_tbl, aes(yintercept = loa_lo), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(data = agree_tbl, aes(yintercept = loa_hi), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ cohort, labeller = as_labeller(cohort_labels)) +
  labs(x = "Mean of d (CP, CD)", y = "d (CP) - d (CD)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)

p_fig <- (p_scatter / p_ba) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
```

# 3 Quantify subject-level agreement between CP and CD values

### Subject-level concordance

```{r}
#| label: subject-level
subj_concordance <- function(dat_cp, dat_cd, rois, labels, id, cohort) {
  stopifnot(identical(dat_cp[[id]], dat_cd[[id]]), all(rois %in% names(labels)))

  long_cp <- dat_cp |>
    select(subject = all_of(id), group, all_of(rois)) |>
    pivot_longer(all_of(rois), names_to = "key", values_to = "cp")
  long_cd <- dat_cd |>
    select(subject = all_of(id), all_of(rois)) |>
    pivot_longer(all_of(rois), names_to = "key", values_to = "cd")

  subj <- inner_join(long_cp, long_cd, by = c("subject", "key")) |>
    filter(!is.na(cp), !is.na(cd))
  stopifnot(nrow(subj) == nrow(drop_na(long_cp)))

  # z-score each metric within ROI
  subj <- subj |>
    mutate(ROI = unname(labels[key]), cohort = cohort) |>
    group_by(key) |>
    mutate(z_cp   = as.numeric(scale(cp)),
           z_cd   = as.numeric(scale(cd)),
           mean_z = (z_cp + z_cd) / 2,
           gap    = z_cp - z_cd) |>
    ungroup()
  stopifnot(!anyNA(subj$ROI))

  conc <- subj |>
    group_by(cohort, ROI) |>
    summarise(
      n               = n(),
      pearson_r       = cor(cp, cd),
      spearman_rho    = cor(cp, cd, method = "spearman"),
      loa             = 1.96 * sd(gap),
      gap_FT_minus_PT = mean(gap[group == "FT"]) - mean(gap[group == "PT"]),
      .groups = "drop") |>
    arrange(pearson_r)

  list(subj = subj, conc = conc)
}

bls_cp <- final_dat_CP |> rename_with(~ sub("^cp_", "", .x), starts_with("cp_"))
bls_cd <- final_dat_CD |> rename_with(~ sub("^cd_", "", .x), starts_with("cd_"))
labels_bls <- setNames(roi_labels, sub("^cp_", "", names(roi_labels)))

res_bls  <- subj_concordance(bls_cp, bls_cd, names(labels_bls), labels_bls,
                             id = "subject", cohort = "BLS")
res_dhcp <- subj_concordance(dat_dHCP_cp, dat_dHCP_cd, names(roi_labels_dHCP), roi_labels_dHCP,
                             id = "subject_id", cohort = "dHCP")

conc_subj <- bind_rows(res_bls$conc, res_dhcp$conc)
```

#### Save table

```{r}
#| label: save-subject
write_csv2(conc_subj, file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_agreement_CPvsCD_subject_concordance_",
                                                format(Sys.Date()), ".csv")))
```
